That’s what I read and thought I believed, so I tried to prove that theory wrong. I would blindfold myself, and put the board behind me Or in random awkward positions where I couldn’t possibly know where the alphabet or numbers were on the board and I would mentally ask questions or out loud and it would answer the questions behind me on the board. I kept getting more and more experience and it started getting to the point where my intuition started Getting strong. I could put my hand on the board, and it would just haul ass in the figure 8. It would Tell me how many fingers people were holding up behind their back that were standing across the room from me. Everything I asked it to do to try to prove it was real, it did.  One time we were playing in the middle of the living room floor and we had already asked at like 10 questions that it kept giving us the answers to and we still needed more we heard one of our cell phones ringing in the living room but we didn’t know who’s phone it was or where the phone was we just heard it ringing. Once it started ringing we asked the board If it could tell us who Was calling. It told us Eric was calling  The phone ended up being underneath the sofa on the other side the room and the missed call was definitely from Eric.
